summary: Iteration 230: Tested mesh snapshot gossip feature and header status dots. All 6 features working correctly. Backend APIs pass (10/11 tests - burned object endpoint times out but works with longer timeout). Frontend status dots render correctly with proper data-testid attributes and tooltips.

minor.issue: Endpoint times out with 30s timeout due to slow external API calls. Works with 60s+ timeout.

critical_code_review_comments: mesh.py: broadcast_snapshot_gossip() function correctly broadcasts CID to all connected WebSocket clients
snapshot.py: _auto_delta_loop() calls broadcast_snapshot_gossip() after producing delta snapshot (line 270-275)
HeaderStatusDots.js: 3 status dots with correct data-testid attributes (header-ipfs-status, header-mesh-status, header-walkie-status)
HeaderStatusDots.js: Mesh dot shows cyan (bg-cyan-400) when connected, gray (bg-gray-700) when off
useMeshRelay.js: _handleSnapshotGossip() auto-consumes incoming snapshot CIDs via /api/snapshot/consume
meshClient.js: setOnSnapshotGossip() callback wired for snapshot-gossip WebSocket messages
meshNode.js: _relaySnapshotGossip() relays snapshot gossip to all connected peers
context_for_next_testing_agent: All mesh gossip features working: (1) GET /api/snapshot/auto-delta/status returns enabled=true with networks array and announce sub-object, (2) GET /api/snapshot/announce/status returns all config fields, (3) POST /api/snapshot/announce/config toggles announcement on/off, (4) Header shows 3 status dots with data-testid attributes (header-ipfs-status, header-mesh-status, header-walkie-status), (5) Mesh dot tooltip shows 'Mesh Connected' or 'Mesh Off', (6) broadcast_snapshot_gossip function exists in mesh.py and is called from snapshot.py after delta production. The burned object endpoint works but requires 60s+ timeout due to slow external API.
